title: Worktree Isolation
description: Use isolated worktree lanes for parallel task execution

steps.content: Implement auth refactor and login UI updates in parallel
steps.annotation: Two active tasks in one workspace would collide
Shared board remains the coordination source of truth
Lane allocation and task association are composable; task 2 binds after lane creation
Control-plane state remains canonical; lifecycle events provide observability

steps.content:
worktree_run(name: "auth-refactor", command: "npm test -- auth")
worktree_run(name: "ui-login", command: "npm test -- login")
steps.annotation: Commands route by lane-scoped cwd; each task runs in its isolated directory
Closeout is explicit: keep one lane, remove another and complete its task

steps.content:
worktree.keep emitted for ui-login
worktree.remove.before/after emitted for auth-refactor
task.completed emitted for #1
.worktrees/events.jsonl appended
steps.annotation: Lifecycle transitions become explicit records while task/worktree files remain source-of-truth

steps.content: Task board handles coordination, worktrees handle isolation. Parallel tracks stayed clean and auditable.
steps.annotation: Tasks answer what; worktrees answer where. Keep them separate.
